package.description: Lightweight tray temperature monitor for CPU, GPU, and NVMe/SATA drives.

en-US.description: Lightweight tray temperature monitor for CPU, GPU, and NVMe/SATA drives.
en-US.longDescription:
tempmanager shows your hottest component's temperature right in the Windows notification area.
Left-click the tray icon for current readings, a history chart, and a sampling-interval slider.
It reads NVIDIA GPUs through NVML, NVMe and SATA drives through Windows storage APIs, and AMD Ryzen CPUs through the AMD Ryzen Master Monitoring SDK.
Written in Rust against native Win32 with no runtime dependencies.
en-US.name: tempmanager
